name: Northwest Communications Cooperative
old_description: Here at Northwest Communications Cooperative, we offer internet, telephone, video and security services that are top-of-the-line and, most importantly, delivered with a handshake and a smile. Based in Ray, North Dakota, we consider northwest North Dakota our neighborhood. Let us know how we can serve you.
about:
Northwest Communications Cooperative operates from its headquarters in Ray, North Dakota, with a second office in Williston. The member-owned cooperative has served the telecommunications needs of northwest North Dakota for decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Organized as a cooperative, it returns capital credits to its members and reinvests in local infrastructure.

The company provides a suite of communications services including high-speed internet, digital video through its NCC Video+ platform, landline and VoIP telephone (NCC iVoice), and security monitoring for both residential and business customers. Service is delivered over a fiber and fixed-wireless network covering the cooperative's service territory. Billing occurs one month in advance with proration from connection date.

Customers range from rural households and farms to small businesses, schools, and community institutions across the region. The cooperative participates in federal grant programs such as the Foundation for Rural Service grants to extend broadband access. It also administers scholarship programs and accepts donation and sponsorship requests for local causes.

The cooperative emphasizes personal, local service — "delivered with a handshake and a smile" — distinguishing itself from national carriers by maintaining a physical presence in the communities it serves. Capital credits allocate margins back to members, reinforcing the member-owned model.
